Source.evidence_source: [page/16/Text/3] Note. All ps < .001. CN is the composite score for negative events (Stable plus global plus internal), CP is the composite score for positive events (Stable plus global plus internal), and CPCN is the depression score at Time 1, CDI2 at Time 2, and CDI3 at Time 3. [page/16/Text/5] To see whether some of the CASQ dimensions would account more for the correlations between the CDI and CASQ, we further looked at the relationships between all dimensions of explanatory style and depression (see Table 4).
